run_extract_attention_maps: run the script to extract and visualize attention maps from a Sapiens model on input images
run_attention_visualization_cli: run the CLI tool with a config, checkpoint, input directory, and output root to generate attention visualizations
review_main_function: review the main function that parses arguments, loads a FeatureExtractor model, and processes images for attention extraction
review_attention_weight_computation: review the attention weight computation using query and key tensors from the model's last attention layer
review_attention_visualization: review the visualization logic that creates 5x5 grid collages and per-head colormap images for each token
